I'm thinking about switching to an e-cigar. I'm looking for one aesthetically as similar to a real cigar as possible including the amount of smoke/vapor, taste, texture, and "chewiness". I've looked all over the internet but either no one makes one or they don't sell online. All I've seen are the same three or four brands that all seem like they would suck. I don't smoke frequently so the amount I'm willing to pay per cigar is a lot higher than most people. Any advice?
I can't say that I've ever seen an e-cigar. Not in my wheelhouse. Maybe try /v/vaping?
If you want to vape, why not just get a good vaporizer? Is it that you like the way a cigar looks, but you do not like cigars?
I like everything about cigars. I'm considering a vape but I think ecigs will be too small, will lack the large cloud of smoke, will feel different, and won't be designed to taste like a cigar.

I used to vape. I would recommend getting a real vaporizer that has rechargeable 18650 batteries and a re-fillable tank. Something like a Nautilus mini or Kanger protank. As far as flavors, it's not going to be like a cigar really. You can find something made to simulate tobacco flavors, but it's just not the same.

Some cigars have a kind of a spicy taste. I don't know cigar-ese for the nature of the taste I'm looking for. I certainly don't want a flavored cigar, at least not what I've seen. That is, I don't want a flavor added to the outside of the tabacco such that the immediate taste is different. I'm also not talking about a nicotine buzz. I'm looking for smoke that tastes like this. Can someone help?

I think this flavor wheel might be very helpful. Spice in cigars generally refers to cinnamon or anise or other actual spices. I think Flor de las Antillas, JD Howard, and My Father cigars are affordable/available cigars that fall into this category.

Pepper is very different than spice and I think that's what you're referring to. Green pepper, red pepper, black pepper, etc...I think some good examples of the peppery profile are: Tatuaje black label, Bolivar Petite Coronas (at first), and Don Pepin Garcia blue label. A lot of cigars start off with a heavy pepper profile, but lose that flavor after the first inch or so. If you're looking for a pepper bomb, I'd say to find the Cu Avana Punisher. I haven't tried one, but from what I hear your lips will be burning.

About the nicotine buzz, that depends on the cigars strength. Full strength means lots of nicotine.

You're the man, man. On a side note I googled the company in the flavor wheel. Would not recommend their site. It's PACKED with trackers and SEO shit. I couldn't even view the page without permitting a tracker.

edit: I now realize the site is just a sales front. It's on this side of "spam" because it provides useful information, but just barely.

Try Nicaraguan, or cigars with more Ligero in them, things like the LFD Digger, Triple Ligero. or the Rocky Patel Super Ligero. The Norteno is also a peppery cigar. Generally anything with a little more strength to it will be a little more peppery.
